> Onur Hüseyin Koçak, a software builder and tech creator in Bangkok. I use your product first, then explain it in Reels and carousels people save, in Turkish and English.

## Rates

- Carousel: $100 USD. One sponsored carousel about your product. Slide count is agreed in the brief.
- USD base rates for one agreed deliverable. The brief defines length, slide count, language, revision scope and publication channel. Paid advertising and extra usage are quoted separately.

## Are the Instagram results annual totals?

No. The account measurements cover 30 completed days, 2026-10-17 to 2026-11-15. Post measurements are lifetime totals. Current followers and the measurement time are shown separately. Source: Meta Graph API; https://ugc-onur.vibecodingturkey.com/assets/creator/snapshot.json.

## Are paid ads and whitelisting included?

No. Paid ads, boosting, whitelisting / Partnership Ads, Spark Ads and dark posts are not included. They are licensed separately in writing.

My published paid partnerships are Brantial (AI-search visibility) and Mostdomain (domain research). Both are disclosed in the caption and shown above with their Instagram measurements.

From the Meta Graph API for the Instagram account @onurhuseyinkocak.ai. Account figures cover the last 30 completed days; post figures are lifetime totals. Every figure carries its measurement date.

## How do we start?

Send the product URL, the format, the usage you need and your target date through the brief form, by email or on Instagram. I reply with a written scope and price before anything is produced.
